decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, supported by powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Violent Urge to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining fast creatures, efficient removal spells, and disruptive elements, this UR Aggro deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive Boros creatures and spells to put pressure on opponents quickly. With a mix of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Prismatic Ending, it aims to overwhelm opponents and finish them off before they can establish their own game plan. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Mana Tithe and Static Prison helps to prevent opponents from stabilizing, while Boromir, Warden of the Tower and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional support and versatility to the deck.

This deck focuses on using land-based ramp and the Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana and summon powerful creatures like Primeval Titan to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck aims to search for key lands and creatures to create a formidable board presence. By utilizing a combination of land recursion and high-impact spells, the deck aims to quickly assemble its key pieces and win the game through a powerful combo or overwhelming board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize powerful combo spells and cards such as Revitalizing Repast, Force of Despair, and Necrodominance to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key focus is to generate value from sacrificing creatures and utilizing the graveyard, while also utilizing cards like Rite of Consumption and Soul Spike to deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Duress to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of combo spells and disruptive cards.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls while utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt to control the board and finish off opponents. The deck also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Goblin Bombardment for additional value and reach. Cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide additional utility and support for the aggro strategy, while cards like Thraben Charm and Solitude offer removal options to help maintain tempo and pressure.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker to generate tokens and sacrifice them for value. By combining these creatures with cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Sowing Mycospawn, the deck can create a powerful board presence quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of Emrakul, the Promised End and Eldrazi Temple allows for explosive plays and game-ending combos. The deck also includes a toolbox of utility lands and spells to support its combo strategy and disrupt opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing various creatures and spells to generate mana and quickly ramp into casting powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It also includes cards that can create token creatures, boost the power of creatures, and disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and powerful spells, while also using cards like Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces of the combo. It utilizes a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements to control the board and secure victory.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy and generate value. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can repeatedly exile and return its own creatures, triggering powerful abilities and creating tempo swings. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push are included for disruption and removal, while cards like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk provide powerful threats. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the board through efficient creature interactions and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively and efficiently, utilizing powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, as well as disruptive cards like Fatal Push and Stubborn Denial, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent while protecting its own key threats. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support and versatility, while the land base allows for consistent mana production. The goal is to establish an early advantage and press forward relentlessly to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly using cards like Ruby Medallion and Pyretic Ritual, while also utilizing Ral, Monsoon Mage's ability to deal damage to the opponent. The deck aims to cast multiple spells in one turn, leading up to a big finish with cards like Grapeshot or Past in Flames. The inclusion of Wish allows for additional flexibility in finding key cards from the sideboard when needed. The deck also features some card drawing and filtering options to help maintain consistency and find the necessary pieces for the combo.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and utilizing powerful enchantments to control the board and pressure the opponent. It combines efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger with disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to maintain tempo and gain advantage on the battlefield. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding helps to protect your creatures and disrupt opposing strategies, while Scion of Draco provides a powerful finisher to close out games quickly. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and control.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through the use of Urza and various artifacts. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, the deck aims to generate mana and card advantage while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells. Urza, Lord High Artificer acts as a powerful win condition, allowing the player to generate a significant advantage through its ability to create large amounts of mana and tokens. The deck also includes various planeswalkers like Tezzeret, Cruel Captain and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to further control the game and generate value.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and other lands, in order to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. It also includes control elements like Wrath of the Skies and Malevolent Rumble to keep the opponent's board in check. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Orim's Chant and Kozilek's Command, while also generating value with cards like Ugin's Labyrinth and Sowing Mycospawn. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and efficient control options.

The deck focuses on using powerful reanimation cards like Persist and Solitude to bring back high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's game plan. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan. It utilizes a mix of card advantage, removal, and reanimation to create a powerful and interactive game plan in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to use the synergy between Broodscale creatures and Eldrazi to create a powerful combo that overwhelms the opponent. By utilizing cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Malevolent Rumble, along with support from Eldrazi like Emrakul, the Promised End, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and control the game. With a mix of removal spells, equipment like Blade of the Bloodchief, and lands like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple, the deck is designed to consistently execute its strategy and outmaneuver the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells to deal damage as quickly and efficiently as possible. It utilizes a combination of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and push through damage. The inclusion of cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Boromir, Warden of the Tower provide additional support and buffs to keep up the pressure on the opponent, while cards like Mana Tithe and Ranger-Captain of Eos provide disruption and protection for the creatures. The deck aims to win the game through a mix of creature combat and direct damage.
